{{Short description|Norwegian physicist (born 1935)}}
'''Kristian Johan Fossheim''' (born 4 December 1935) is a Norwegian physicist.
[[File:Kristian Johan Fossheim.jpg|thumb|Kristian Johan Fossheim]]
He was born in [[Jølster Municipality]]. He took the [[dr.philos.]] degree in 1972, was an associate professor at the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] from 1970 to 1980, and professor from 1980.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=2007|title=Kristian Johan Fossheim|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]]|editor=Henriksen, Petter|publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget|location=Oslo|url=http://www.snl.no/Kristian_Johan_Fossheim|language=Norwegian|accessdate=5 March 2009}}</ref> He has been vice-praeses of the [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dknvs.no/boardadministration.htm|title=Board/administration|publisher=Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters|accessdate=7 June 2007|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20071020114739/http://www.dknvs.no/boardadministration.htm|archivedate=20 October 2007}}</ref> and is a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27625|title=Gruppe 2: Fysikkfag (herunder astronomi, fysikk og geofysikk)|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=28 October 2009}}</ref> and the 
[[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ntva.no/index.php?option=com_club&view=member&id=134%3Afossheim-kristian&Itemid=60|title=Medlemmer: FOSSHEIM, Kristian|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=11 May 2013}}</ref>
